# Rule 2.1 - Powergaming
Omu is a server focused on roleplay, not playing the game to win. Focusing excessively towards achieving quantifiable goals instead of attempting to play a role is not allowed. This includes "textbaiting," or intentionally attacking someone while they are typing.
Additionally, there are unacceptable levels of equipping yourself, as it promotes strictly “to win” mindsets and playstyles. Anything you carry on your person or in your respective department must have clear, explicit in-character motivation to have been acquired. (NT hires [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] for your protection, after all.)
[italic]The Station’s alert level acts as a general guide to what can and cannot be carried or acquired at the moment.[/italic]
## Precedents
- Carrying the Deckard as [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color] on anything less than [color=#ba292c]Red Alert[/color], unless you personally have had an attempt on your life. - As a [color=#ba292c][bold]Security Officer[/bold][/color], carrying an excessive amount of medical supplies (such as more than one security autoinjector or stack of topicals) instead of relying on the assigned [color=#ba292c][bold]Corpsman[/bold][/color] or the [color=#42636d][bold]Medical[/bold][/color] department. - Making homebrew weapons to carry, or [italic]”tiding”[/italic] for such weapons (Cable ties, Bats, etc.) - Making highly toxic chemical mixes for defensive purposes while [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] is still capable of defending the station. - As a member of [color=#846326]Cargo[/color] or [color=#846326]Salvage[/color], mass purchasing firearms for usage strictly on station. - Acquiring other departments' techfab boards to avoid having to interact with them later on. - Acquiring weapons you have no reason to want at the moment the alert level raises. - As the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Blueshield Officer[/bold][/color], usage or acquisition of a firearm typically reserved for security purposes. This includes if you have chosen Dragon Kung Fu from the weapon selector. Your weapon selector provides you with all of the tools required for your position. - As implied above, you should be using the gear issued to your post, not swapping out to exotic nonstandard gear. To that end, giving away gear that is issued to specifically your job to others in your department is forbidden. [italic](An exception to this is traitors attempting to [textlink="buy or blackmail you" link="RuleRoleplayAboveAll"] for items, which is allowed.)[/italic] - For [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color], [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color], and [color=#1e7f28][bold]Central Command[/bold][/color], usage of contraband or enchantments is [bold]HIGHLY[/bold] restricted. There is virtually no reason to enchant gear or use antagonist gear of any kind except in a direct effort to stop a station ending threat. This includes [textlink="Nuclear Operatives" link="NuclearOperatives"], [bold]Ascended[/bold] [textlink="Heretics" link="Heretics"], [textlink="Zombies" link="Zombies"], [textlink="Chimera" link="Letoferol"], or similar [italic]certain doom[/italic]. - Intentionally beginning a conversation, then attacking without warning while the other person is typing a response.
